 BEFORE  HONOURABLE MRS. JUSTICE MALASRI NANDI  ORDER Date : 14.06.2024 Heard Mr. A. Islam, learned counsel for the applicant.

Also heard Mr. B. Sarma,
learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State/respondent No.2 and Mr. S. Sahu, learned counsel for the respondent No.1.
The learned counsel for the respondent No. 1 submits that the charge-sheet has already been laid in this case without implicating the accused/respondent.
The copy of charge-sheet has not been available in the record.

The Registry is directed to procure the charge-sheet in connection with Laharighat P.S. Case No.
36/2024 under Section 376 DA IPC r/w Section 6 of POCSO Act.
List on 27.06.2024.
